data: Does increasing the amount of training data for the discourse parser improve accuracy on the Yelp review task?

The caption states that varying the amount of training data for the discourse parser affects parsing F1 performance and accuracy on the Yelp review task. The graph shows an upward trend in accuracy on the Yelp review task as the F1 score on the RST Discourse Treebank increases. This suggests that increasing the amount of training data for the discourse parser improves accuracy on the Yelp review task.
